_: The single manifest of the Perch public package: the privacy guard scans everything
include expands to (dotfiles count), and export-perch.py copies by it. To keep something
out of the scan, the only way is an explicit neverCopy entry with a reason.

neverCopy.**/.omc/**: Local editor/session state. Contains full /Users/<name>/... paths, executed commands, and session ids. gitignore keeps it out of this repo, but a cp -R extraction would drag it into the new repo, and one git add . puts it in public history.
neverCopy.**/.DS_Store: Finder's per-machine file; carries directory-browsing traces.
